title: PIP-II Dipole Magnets
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.FERMILAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (FNAL) is soliciting proposals for the design, fabrication, assembly, testing and delivery of PIP-II Beam Transfer Line (BTL) Dipole Magnets in accordance with the attached Statement of Work. Proposal can be submitted directly to the Primary Contact listed on this solicitation notice and within the RFP Document. The Attachement B. Drawing Files are available upon request from the Primary Contact listed on this solicitation notice and within the RFP Document.
